title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 701–750 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: I use the internet to search for school information.
examples.zh: 我使用網際網路來搜尋學校資訊。

examples.en: Fast and reliable internet access is essential for remote work.
examples.zh: 高速穩定的網路連線對遠端工作至關重要。

examples.en: You can browse recipes and watch cooking videos on the internet.
examples.zh: 你可以在網路上瀏覽食譜並觀看烹飪影片。

examples.en: Visit our official website for the latest updates.
examples.zh: 歡迎造訪我們的官方網站以獲取最新消息。

examples.en: The government website offers convenient online tax filing services.
examples.zh: 政府網站提供了便捷的線上報稅服務。

examples.en: Bookmark this educational website so you can practice English anytime.
examples.zh: 把這個教學網站加入書籤，這樣你隨時都能練習英文。

examples.en: Online shopping has become very convenient in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣線上購物已經變得非常方便。

examples.en: Many students take online courses to learn programming languages.
examples.zh: 許多學生透過線上課程學習程式語言。

examples.en: Is customer service available online twenty-four hours a day?
examples.zh: 客服人員有提供全天候二十四小時線上服務嗎？

examples.en: You can track the bus arrival time using this app.
examples.zh: 你可以用這款 APP 查詢公車到站時間。

examples.en: Download our fitness app to record your daily running routes and calories.
examples.zh: 下載我們的健身 APP 來記錄每日慢跑路線與卡路里。

examples.en: Mobile banking apps make transferring money safe and effortless.
examples.zh: 行動銀行 APP 讓轉帳變得既安全又省力。

examples.en: Click the link below to join the online meeting.
examples.zh: 點擊下方連結以加入線上會議。

examples.en: Double click the desktop folder icon to view stored photos.
examples.zh: 按兩下桌面資料夾圖示以檢視儲存的照片。

examples.en: With just a single click, your order will be placed successfully.
examples.zh: 只需輕輕一點，你的訂單就能成功送出。

examples.en: Search for English tutorials on YouTube.
examples.zh: 在 YouTube 上搜尋英語教學影片。

examples.en: Police launched an extensive search for the missing hiker in the mountains.
examples.zh: 警方在山區對失蹤的登山客展開了全面搜救。

examples.en: Use specific keywords to search the university database efficiently.
examples.zh: 使用具體關鍵字可以有效率地檢索大學資料庫。

examples.en: She can type very fast without looking at the keyboard.
examples.zh: 她打字非常快，不用看鍵盤。

examples.en: What type of cuisine do you prefer for tonight's dinner?
examples.zh: 今晚的晚餐你偏好哪種類型的料理？

examples.en: Please type your full name and email address in the registration form.
examples.zh: 請在報名表中鍵入你的全名與電子信箱。

examples.en: Staring at the screen for too long hurts your eyes.
examples.zh: 盯著螢幕太久會傷害你的眼睛。

examples.en: Modern smartphone screens adjust brightness automatically according to room lighting.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機螢幕會依據室內光線自動調整亮度。

examples.en: He installed a protective glass film over the tablet screen.
examples.zh: 他在平板螢幕上貼了一層玻璃保護貼。

examples.en: Clean your computer keyboard regularly to remove dust.
examples.zh: 定期清潔電腦鍵盤以清除灰塵。

examples.en: Mechanical keyboards offer satisfying tactile feedback while typing code.
examples.zh: 機械式鍵盤在敲寫程式碼時能提供令人滿意的段落觸感。

examples.en: Wireless keyboards connect seamlessly via Bluetooth to laptops.
examples.zh: 無線鍵盤可透過藍牙無縫連接至筆記型電腦。

examples.en: A smooth mouse pad helps you move the cursor accurately.
examples.zh: 一塊平滑的滑鼠墊能幫你精準移動游標。

examples.en: Gamers often choose oversized desk mouse pads for swift hand movements.
examples.zh: 電競玩家常選擇超大桌上滑鼠墊以便快速移動雙手。

examples.en: The ergonomic gel mouse pad provides comfortable wrist support during long hours.
examples.zh: 符合人體工學的凝膠滑鼠墊在長時間使用時提供舒適的手腕支撐。

examples.en: Turn on the light when the room gets dark.
examples.zh: 天色變暗時請把電燈打開。

examples.en: It is boiling hot inside; please turn on the air conditioner.
examples.zh: 室內熱得受不了，請把冷氣打開。

examples.en: Press the power button to turn on your computer.
examples.zh: 按下電源按鈕以啟動電腦。

examples.en: Please turn off your mobile phone during the concert.
examples.zh: 音樂會進行時請關閉手機電源。

examples.en: Remember to turn off all electrical appliances before leaving home.
examples.zh: 出門前請記得關閉所有電器設備。

examples.en: Turn off the bedroom lamp so we can get some restful sleep.
examples.zh: 關掉臥室檯燈，這樣我們才能好好睡一覺。

examples.en: Could you turn up the volume a little bit?
examples.zh: 能把音量稍微調大一點嗎？

examples.en: She turned up the heater because the winter wind was freezing.
examples.zh: 因為寒冬凜冽，她把電暖器溫度調高了。

examples.en: He didn't turn up for the morning meeting due to sudden traffic delays.
examples.zh: 由於突發的交通延誤，他沒有在早晨的會議上現身。

examples.en: Please turn down the music; grandma is sleeping.
examples.zh: 請把音樂關小聲點，奶奶正在睡覺。

examples.en: He had to turn down the job offer because the commute was too long.
examples.zh: 因為通勤路程太遙遠，他不得不婉拒那份工作邀約。

examples.en: Turn down the stove flame to a simmer after the soup boils.
examples.zh: 湯滾後把爐火轉小繼續燉煮。

examples.en: Plug in the toaster to make some crispy bread.
examples.zh: 插上烤麵包機電源來烤幾片酥脆麵包。

examples.en: Make sure your electric vehicle is plugged in to recharge overnight.
examples.zh: 確認電動車已插上充電插頭以便夜間充電。

examples.en: Plug in the headphones so you can listen to music without disturbing others.
examples.zh: 插上耳機，這樣你就能聽音樂而不打擾他人。

examples.en: My phone battery is low; I need a power bank.
examples.zh: 我的手機快沒電了，需要行動電源。

examples.en: Replace the smoke detector's alkaline battery once every year.
examples.zh: 每年更換一次火災煙霧偵測器的鹼性電池。

examples.en: Electric cars run on rechargeable lithium-ion battery packs.
examples.zh: 電動車仰賴可充電的鋰離子電池組驅動。

examples.en: It takes one hour to charge this phone fully.
examples.zh: 這支手機充滿電需要一個小時。

examples.en: The hotel does not charge any extra fees for wireless internet access.
examples.zh: 該飯店對無線網路使用不收取任何額外費用。

examples.en: The police officer charged the reckless driver with speeding through red lights.
examples.zh: 員警對這名闖紅燈超速的魯莽駕駛提出控告。

examples.en: Did you remember to pack your phone charger?
examples.zh: 你有記得把手機充電器放進行李嗎？

examples.en: Carry a universal travel charger when traveling across foreign countries.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊跨國旅行時請攜帶萬用旅行充電轉接頭。

examples.en: This magnetic wireless charger powers your smart watch conveniently on the desk.
examples.zh: 這款磁吸式無線充電器能方便地在桌上為智慧手錶充電。

examples.en: The sudden storm caused a power outage in the village.
examples.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨造成村莊停電。

examples.en: Taiwan is actively investing in offshore wind and solar power.
examples.zh: 台灣正積極投資離岸風電與太陽能發電。

examples.en: Knowledge is power that enables individuals to overcome life challenges.
examples.zh: 知識就是力量，賦予人們克服人生挑戰的能力。

examples.en: Is there free Wi-Fi available at this cafe?
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳有提供免費無線網路嗎？

examples.en: What is the password to connect to the hotel lobby Wi-Fi?
examples.zh: 連接飯店大廳 Wi-Fi 的密碼是什麼？

examples.en: The public library provides fast, secure Wi-Fi for all visitors.
examples.zh: 這座公共圖書館為所有讀者提供快速且安全的無線網路。

examples.en: Drink plenty of warm water when running a fever.
examples.zh: 發燒時請多喝溫開水。

examples.en: The pediatrician measured the toddler's high fever with an ear thermometer.
examples.zh: 小兒科醫生用耳溫槍為幼兒測量高燒體溫。

examples.en: World Cup football fever swept through fans all across the nation.
examples.zh: 世界盃足球賽的狂熱席捲了全國各地的球迷。

examples.en: Wear a face mask if you have a cold and cough.
examples.zh: 如果你感冒咳嗽，請戴上口罩。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed herbal cough drops to soothe his dry throat.
examples.zh: 醫生開了草本止咳喉糖來舒緩他乾咳的喉嚨。

examples.en: Cover your mouth with your elbow whenever you cough or sneeze.
examples.zh: 咳嗽或打噴嚏時，請務必用手肘遮住口鼻。

examples.en: Take a short break if you have a severe headache.
examples.zh: 如果你頭痛劇烈，稍微休息一下吧。

examples.en: Working in front of glare screens without breaks often triggers painful headaches.
examples.zh: 長時間在刺眼螢幕前工作不休息常會引發令人難受的頭痛。

examples.en: A warm cup of chamomile tea helped relieve her tension headache.
examples.zh: 一杯溫熱的洋甘菊茶幫助緩解了她的緊繃型頭痛。

examples.en: Eating spoiled food can cause a bad stomachache.
examples.zh: 吃壞掉的食物會引發嚴重胃痛。

examples.en: The student went to the school nurse's office complaining of a stomachache.
examples.zh: 這名學生因肚子痛而前往學校健康中心。

examples.en: Drinking warm ginger water can help ease a mild stomachache.
examples.zh: 喝溫熱的薑茶有助於緩解輕微的胃部不適。

examples.en: You should visit a dentist if you have a toothache.
examples.zh: 如果你牙痛，應該去看牙醫。

examples.en: A throbbing toothache kept him awake the entire night.
examples.zh: 陣陣抽痛的牙痛讓他整夜無法入眠。

examples.en: Neglecting dental cavities will eventually lead to a severe toothache.
examples.zh: 忽視蛀牙最終會導致劇烈的牙痛。

examples.en: Take your cold medicine after meals three times a day.
examples.zh: 感冒藥請三餐飯後服用。

examples.en: Traditional Chinese medicine often uses natural roots and herbs.
examples.zh: 傳統中醫藥常使用天然植物根部與草藥。

examples.en: Modern medicine has made remarkable advances in treating complex diseases.
examples.zh: 現代醫學在治療複雜疾病方面取得了顯著的進展。

examples.en: Swallow the pill with a glass of lukewarm water.
examples.zh: 用一杯溫水將藥丸吞下。

examples.en: Vitamin C pills help support your body's immune system.
examples.zh: 維生素 C 藥片有助於維持身體的免疫系統運作。

examples.en: The doctor advised taking one allergy relief pill before bedtime.
examples.zh: 醫生建議在睡前服用一顆抗過敏藥丸。

examples.en: You need plenty of bed rest to recover quickly.
examples.zh: 你需要多臥床休息以迅速康復。

examples.en: Take a five-minute rest after studying continuously for an hour.
examples.zh: 連續專注研讀一小時後，請休息五分鐘。

examples.en: We will finish reviewing the rest of the project slides tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我們明天早晨會把剩餘的專案投影片全部檢視完畢。

examples.en: Good night! Sleep well and sweet dreams.
examples.zh: 晚安！睡個好覺，祝好夢。

examples.en: Ensure your bedroom is dark and quiet so you can sleep well.
examples.zh: 確保臥室陰暗安靜，這樣你才能睡個好覺。

examples.en: Exercising regularly helps people sleep well without needing medications.
examples.zh: 規律運動有助於人們睡得香甜而無需依賴藥物。

examples.en: My left knee hurts after running ten laps.
examples.zh: 跑了十圈後我的左膝蓋很痛。

examples.en: Be careful playing on the playground so you don't get hurt.
examples.zh: 在遊樂場玩耍時要當心，別讓自己受傷了。

examples.en: Harsh words can hurt someone's feelings deeply for a long time.
examples.zh: 刻薄刺耳的話語會深深傷害別人的感情長達許久。

examples.en: Be careful with the scissors so you don't cut yourself.
examples.zh: 拿剪刀時請小心，別割傷自己。

examples.en: He cut himself while slicing fresh tomatoes with a sharp kitchen knife.
examples.zh: 他在用鋒利菜刀切新鮮番茄時不慎割傷了自己。

examples.en: If you accidentally cut yourself, wash the small wound with clean water immediately.
examples.zh: 如果你不小心割傷自己，請立即用清水清洗小傷口。

examples.en: Press a clean tissue on the wound if it bleeds.
examples.zh: 如果傷口流血，請用乾淨面紙按壓。

examples.en: The scrape began to bleed slightly after he fell off the skateboard.
examples.zh: 他從滑板上摔下來後，擦傷處開始微微滲血。

examples.en: Tilt your head forward and pinch your nose gently if your nose bleeds.
examples.zh: 如果流鼻血，請將頭稍微前傾並輕捏鼻樑。

examples.en: Put a band-aid on your scraped finger.
examples.zh: 在擦傷的手指上貼一張 OK 繃。

examples.en: The mother placed a cute cartoon band-aid on her daughter's grazed knee.
examples.zh: 母親在女兒擦破皮的膝蓋上貼了一張可愛的卡通 OK 繃。

examples.en: Keep a supply of sterile band-aids in your home first-aid kit.
examples.zh: 在家中的急救箱裡常備一些無菌 OK 繃。

examples.en: Double check your test answers before handing it in.
examples.zh: 交卷前仔細核對你的測驗答案。

examples.en: Hotel guests can check in at the reception desk starting from 3:00 PM.
examples.zh: 飯店住客可自下午三點起在接待櫃台辦理入住登記。

examples.en: The technician arrived early to check the building's fire alarms.
examples.zh: 技術人員很早就抵達以檢查大樓的火災警報器。

examples.en: The doctor called to share the good test results.
examples.zh: 醫生打電話通知良好的檢驗結果。

examples.en: Students waited anxiously for the university entrance exam test results.
examples.zh: 學生們焦急地等待著大學入學考試的成績揭曉。

examples.en: Routine blood test results help doctors assess your overall health profile.
examples.zh: 例行血液檢查結果有助於醫師評估你的整體健康概況。

examples.en: We care deeply about animal welfare and nature.
examples.zh: 我們非常關心動物福利與大自然。

examples.en: Thank you for your thoughtful advice; take care of yourself!
examples.zh: 謝謝你貼心的建議，請多保重身體！

examples.en: Excellent medical care saved the critically injured patient's life.
examples.zh: 精湛的醫療照護挽救了重傷病患的生命。

examples.en: Big sister helps take care of the puppy at home.
examples.zh: 姊姊在家幫忙照料小狗。

examples.en: You must learn to take care of yourself when living abroad independently.
examples.zh: 隻身在國外獨立生活時，你必須學會照顧自己。

examples.en: Experienced nursery nurses take care of newborn infants tenderly.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的育嬰護理師溫柔地照料新生嬰兒。

examples.en: Who will look after your pet cat while you are away?
examples.zh: 你不在時誰會幫忙照料你的寵物貓？

examples.en: She kindly offered to look after her neighbor's plants during their vacation.
examples.zh: 她熱心主動提議在鄰居度假期間幫忙照料他們的盆栽。

examples.en: Parents work tirelessly to protect and look after their growing children.
examples.zh: 父母辛勤工作，以保護與悉心照顧逐漸成長的孩子。

examples.en: Sunflowers grow quickly in sunny weather.
examples.zh: 向日葵在陽光普照的天氣裡生長迅速。

examples.en: Organic farmers grow luscious strawberries without artificial chemical pesticides.
examples.zh: 有機農民不使用人工化學農藥培育鮮美多汁的草莓。

examples.en: Demand for eco-friendly electric vehicles continues to grow worldwide.
examples.zh: 全球對環保電動車的需求持續強勁增長。

examples.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
examples.zh: 你長大後想要做什麼工作？

examples.en: I grew up in a tranquil fishing village along the east coast.
examples.zh: 我在東海岸一個安寧純樸的漁村長大。

examples.en: Children grow up so fast before parents even realize it.
examples.zh: 在父母察覺之前，孩子們就已經飛快地長大成人了。

examples.en: She worked hard to become an excellent teacher.
examples.zh: 她努力用功成為了一名優秀的老師。

examples.en: Autumn arrives in November, and the weather gradually becomes cool.
examples.zh: 十一月秋意漸濃，天氣逐漸變得涼爽。

examples.en: After years of friendship, they decided to become business partners.
examples.zh: 經過多年的深厚情誼，他們決定成為事業合夥人。

examples.en: Keep the change, thank you very much!
examples.zh: 找零不用找了，非常感謝！

examples.en: He wants to change his career and enter the technology industry.
examples.zh: 他想要轉換職業跑道，進入科技產業發展。

examples.en: The unpredictable mountain climate can change from sunny to rainy in minutes.
examples.zh: 變化莫測的山區氣候可能在幾分鐘內由晴轉雨。

examples.en: The movie is about to start; take your seats.
examples.zh: 電影馬上就要開始了，請就座。

examples.en: Let's start the morning project meeting with a brief round of introductions.
examples.zh: 讓我們用簡短的一輪自我介紹來開啟今晨的專案會議。

examples.en: She plans to start her own online boutique clothing business next spring.
examples.zh: 她計劃在明年春天創立屬於自己的線上精品服飾事業。

examples.en: I always finish my homework before having dinner.
examples.zh: 我總是在吃晚餐前把功課寫完。

examples.en: The marathon runner crossed the finish line with triumphant tears.
examples.zh: 馬拉松跑者熱淚盈眶、滿懷勝利喜悅地衝過終點線。

examples.en: How long will it take our team to finish the quarterly audit?
examples.zh: 我們團隊需要花多久時間才能完成本季度的稽核作業？

examples.en: Are you ready for the big sports match?
examples.zh: 你為那場大型體育比賽做好準備了嗎？

examples.en: Dinner is ready; please wash your hands and come to the table.
examples.zh: 晚餐準備好了，請洗洗手過來餐桌用餐。

examples.en: The rescue team stands ready to respond to natural disaster emergencies.
examples.zh: 搜救隊伍隨時嚴陣以待，迅速應對各類自然災害緊急情勢。

examples.en: Hurry and get ready for school!
examples.zh: 快點準備好去上學！

examples.en: Put on your pajamas and get ready for bed.
examples.zh: 換上睡衣，準備上床睡覺囉。

examples.en: Athletes stretch thoroughly on the track to get ready for the 100-meter sprint.
examples.zh: 田徑選手在跑道上徹底拉筋暖身，為百米衝刺做好準備。

examples.en: Would you like to join our school badminton club?
examples.zh: 你想加入我們學校的羽球社嗎？

examples.en: Thousands of passionate runners joined the Taipei International Marathon.
examples.zh: 數以千計熱情的跑者參加了台北國際馬拉松大賽。

examples.en: The new railway bridge will join the two coastal cities together.
examples.zh: 這座新的鐵路大橋將把兩座濱海城市緊密連結在一起。

examples.en: The train will leave the platform in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 火車將在十分鐘後駛離月台。

examples.en: Never leave young children unattended in a parked car.
examples.zh: 切勿將年幼孩童單獨留在停放的汽車內。

examples.en: She applied for three days of annual leave to attend a family wedding.
examples.zh: 她請了三天年假去參加親戚的家族婚禮。

examples.en: The flight will arrive at Taoyuan Airport on schedule.
examples.zh: 班機將準時抵達桃園機場。

examples.en: We arrived at the scenic campsite just as the sun set behind the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們在夕陽剛好落入山巒後方時抵達了風景秀麗的露營地。

examples.en: Guests began to arrive early carrying festive holiday gift baskets.
examples.zh: 客人們提早陸續抵達，手上提著洋溢節慶氛圍的賀禮籃。

words.definition: 到達；伸出；伸手可及之處

examples.en: We finally reached our mountain cabin before sunset.
examples.zh: 我們終於在日落前抵達了山間小屋。

examples.en: Can you reach the top shelf to hand me that ceramic bowl?
examples.zh: 你夠得到最頂層的架子幫我拿下那個瓷碗嗎？

examples.en: The company aims to reach one million active users by year end.
examples.zh: 該公司的目標是在今年底前達成一百萬名活躍用戶大關。
